title: CBSA: importing by mail or courier — determining duty and taxes owed
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. CBSA reviews international mail and decides whether duty and/or taxes apply. Most imported goods are subject to GST and PST or HST; the amount depends on the item's value in Canadian dollars, whether it is a gift and any legislated exemptions. Under the Postal Imports Remission Order an item worth CAN$20 or less is not charged duty or tax; above that, duty, GST/HST and any PST apply to the full value. The page also announces surtaxes on certain U.S. goods from 8 September 2026.
